low_level_plan.meaning: Approach the visually tracked crate and align the pushing direction.
low_level_plan.guard: Target 0.95 m behind the visually tracked crate; <0.13 m position and <0.16 rad heading error.

low_level_plan.meaning: Deploy the pushing posture, lower commanded height smoothly, and anchor to the stationary crate.
low_level_plan.guard: 3 s blend; height command ramps 0.72 to 0.65 m; visual anchor corrections restricted to <0.25 m.

low_level_plan.meaning: Advance with visual crate tracking, lateral correction and heading feedback.
low_level_plan.guard: Forward command 0.18 m/s, lateral correction capped at 0.08 m/s; stop at estimated remaining distance <0.06 m; stale tracking >1 s stops translation.

low_level_plan.meaning: Retreat until own odometry or fresh RGB plus own FK indicates release clearance.
low_level_plan.guard: Backward command 0.30 m/s; release after >0.20 m estimated retreat OR fresh RGB (<0.3 s) and own-FK clearance >0.08 m.

low_level_plan.meaning: Hold the crouched posture for one second after retreat.
low_level_plan.guard: 1 s at zero commanded velocity and 0.65 m height command.

low_level_plan.meaning: Retract the arms while smoothly restoring the standing height command.
low_level_plan.guard: 3 s blend; height command ramps 0.65 to 0.72 m.

low_level_plan.meaning: Move to the post-push robot subgoal and complete the operation.
low_level_plan.guard: Post-push robot subgoal: <0.13 m position and <0.16 rad heading error.
